description: This file contains configuration scripts and Python functions for generating and updating syslog-ng configuration files, including metadata creation, filter and destination updates, and property settings, specific to a build environment.

methods.name: generate_syslog_ng_config
methods.description: Main function to generate syslog-ng configuration by calling other update functions.

methods.name: create_metadata_file
methods.description: Creates metadata and filter configuration files for syslog-ng, appending device-specific service info.

methods.name: update_constants
methods.description: Updates syslog-ng configuration constants, including version and log path.

methods.name: update_filters
methods.description: Updates syslog-ng filter rules based on metadata and filter files.

methods.name: update_destination
methods.description: Configures syslog-ng destination paths based on metadata.

methods.name: update_log
methods.description: Updates syslog-ng log statements with filtering based on log rate and destination.

methods.name: clear_tmp_files
methods.description: Removes temporary filter and metadata directories.

methods.name: update_properties
methods.description: Sets device property to enable syslog-ng.
